paper.subtitle: Duration-Aware and Multivariate Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection for High-Frequency Markets

paper_claims_used: The tested data are signed high-frequency order-flow series for AAPL and MSFT from LOBSTER.
The modeled quantity is aggregated signed volume in volume-clock or one-minute buckets, not daily returns.
Duration-aware BOCPD/BOSD with a log-normal duration law outperformed constant-hazard BOCPD in the univariate order-flow tests.
The log-normal duration law dominated the geometric and Pareto alternatives across assets, months, and calibration criteria.
The multivariate BOCPDMS/BVAR extension was negative on the bivariate order-flow test, underperforming two independent univariate filters.
Heavy-tailed innovations and short regimes made adaptive multivariate coefficients overreact to spikes.
The paper reports no trading strategy, no transaction-cost-adjusted Sharpe, and no ETF allocation test.

group_a_plusplus_context.data_gap: The repository has daily OHLCV and some intraday bars, but this paper's core input is signed transaction/order-flow data. Without reliable trade signs, direct import would create a proxy risk.
group_a_plusplus_context.important_mismatch: The paper studies high-frequency microstructure regime detection; GroupA++ latest strategy is a small ETF allocation system. The fit is strongest for execution-risk advisory, not for changing strategic target weights.

adoption_candidates.name: duration_aware_intraday_order_flow_changepoint_shadow
adoption_candidates.group_a_plusplus_mapping: Use a log-normal duration-aware BOCPD/BOSD filter on signed intraday volume for 0050, 00631L, 00632R, 00713, 00679B, and 2330 when reliable trade-sign data exists.
adoption_candidates.expected_advantage: Could flag execution-time flow breaks earlier than daily OHLCV indicators, especially before adding leveraged 00631L exposure or resizing the 00713/cash sleeve.
adoption_candidates.success_gate: Taiwan intraday signed-flow backtest must reduce after-cost slippage/drawdown versus the current execution guard across purged forward windows.

adoption_candidates.name: lognormal_duration_prior_for_regime_monitors
adoption_candidates.group_a_plusplus_mapping: When a future GroupA++ monitor models event durations online, compare constant-hazard BOCPD against a log-normal run-length hazard instead of assuming geometric regime lengths.
adoption_candidates.expected_advantage: The paper's strongest positive result is that order-flow regimes have no single characteristic timescale; a log-normal duration prior may reduce over-fragmentation of stable periods.
adoption_candidates.success_gate: Predeclared MSE/log-likelihood/false-alarm tests on local Taiwan data.

adoption_candidates.name: daily_ohlcv_proxy_order_flow_regime_gate
adoption_candidates.group_a_plusplus_mapping: Do not replace signed trade flow with daily OHLCV or rough volume-return proxies for live allocation decisions.
adoption_candidates.expected_advantage: None with current evidence; the paper's signal is defined on signed high-frequency transactions.
adoption_candidates.success_gate: Requires direct trade-sign reconstruction or exchange-quality intraday order-flow data.

adoption_candidates.name: multivariate_bocpdms_bvar_live_gate
adoption_candidates.group_a_plusplus_mapping: Do not add a multivariate Bayesian VAR changepoint gate to latest strategy weights.
adoption_candidates.expected_advantage: Not supported by this paper: the bivariate BOCPDMS experiment underperformed two independent univariate filters, and pairwise DM tests did not establish superiority.
adoption_candidates.success_gate: Only reconsider after a separate Taiwan intraday experiment with robust scaling, intercept models, and a populated model universe.

decision.recommended_next_step: Do not change latest strategy weights. If reliable Taiwan signed intraday flow becomes available, build a duration-aware univariate order-flow changepoint shadow for execution timing only.
